tables.title: Effect of low-power modes on HPDMA
tables.text_helper: Table 93, "Effect of low-power modes on HPDMA", in section 18.6 (HPDMA in low-power modes) on page 891. Columns: Mode, Description. 3 data row(s). Notes: 1. Refer to Section18.3.3 to know if Stop mode is supported or not.

rows: No effect. HPDMA interrupts cause the device to exit Sleep mode.
The content of HPDMA registers is kept when entering Stop mode.
The HPDMA is powered down, and must be reinitialized after exiting Standby mode.
notes: 1. Refer to Section18.3.3 to know if Stop mode is supported or not.
